correctness.rationale: Direct symbolic transfer gives the Jury inequalities. For fixed sum, the eigenvalue modulus is decreasing in product before the repeated-root threshold and increasing after; the positive-product boundary at sum one is excluded. For repeated-root optimum N=P-rI is nilpotent and has exact Frobenius norm 1+a; determinant-one singular-value algebra yields the finite-horizon norm, strictly ordered by first rate. Exact symbolic/finite numerical checks in verify.py passed; the written proof supplies universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: The complete exact classification is motivated by finite delay in gradient reuse. It quantifies an unexpected 50-percent larger stable fixed-sum learning-rate budget, a unique balance-to-critical-damping transition, an unattained zero-rate edge, and a rigorous finite-time order penalty invisible to Floquet eigenvalues. These are interpretable, meaningful sharp boundary/optimization facts for the minimal nontrivial stale-gradient recursion, with explicit warnings against unqualified algorithmic generalization.
